correctness.rationale: The proof fully derives all petal-pair constraints, shows a hub must retain at least one complete petal, and compares exact unilateral payoffs: a hub prefers an outside block precisely when its petal count exceeds the hub petal count. This gives the exact iff Nash characterization and restricted-Stirling count. Exact coalition-edge welfare calculations show the full welfare spectrum, an unrestricted optimum of \(m+1\) achieved in exactly \(m\) Nash partitions, and a unique worst Nash grand coalition of welfare \(6m/(2m+1)\) for every integer \(m\ge1\). The standalone checker independently enumerated 700651 partitions for \(m=1,2,3,4,5\), matching counts, Nash status and extrema with exact arithmetic. The finite checks are corroboration, not the infinite proof.

evidence: Hanaka–Ikeyama–Ono 2023, Theorem 1: there exists a welfare optimum on every unweighted block graph with clique/star coalitions; Theorem 2: an algorithm finds optimum welfare.
Bilò et al. 2018, Observation 3: the grand coalition is stable for nonnegative weights; Theorem 3 gives a broad linear upper bound on welfare inefficiency.
Neither of these broad statements classifies every stable partition or counts them by the number of petals and outside coalition blocks.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The general 2023 structural existence theorem can recover some existence/optimal welfare information but is not a characterization of Nash equilibria. The 2018 grand-coalition observation subsumes only the existence of the worst Nash example, while its broad asymptotic bound does not imply the exact coefficient or exact restricted-Stirling multiplicities. These overlaps are credited and not claimed as new.

originality.rationale: The exact Nash-characterization, restricted-Bell equilibrium count, and equilibrium-stratified welfare spectrum on triangular friendship networks were compared with the block-graph optimization theorem (Hanaka et al. 2023), general Nash-stability results (Bilò et al. 2018), the original fractional model (Aziz et al. 2017), and neighboring graph-invariant records. The identified general results do not logically determine these new exact assertions. A finite set of inspections cannot certify global publication priority; the named residual risks remain.

Nash and welfare are model-sensitive; results in modified fractional hedonic games with a different denominator are not comparable without rederivation.

value.rationale: A complete and explicitly enumerable Nash spectrum for the natural diameter-two friendship block graph is a meaningful classification, not a single example. The petal-size cutoff produces restricted Bell-number multiplicities and a complete equilibrium welfare distribution, while exact PoS=1 and PoA growing linearly separate best from worst decentralized coalition arrangements. The findings motivate studying coalition-size dilution on other shared-hub networks; no general hardness or large downstream theorem is asserted.
